correctness.rationale: The independent replay of the ordinary open-neighborhood complex reconstructed 93,350 nonempty faces, 583,750 cover relations and an acyclic 46,529-pair matching with one critical vertex, 246 three-cells and 45 four-cells. Signed integral elimination gives a 246-by-45 matrix with 1,051 nonzeros and exact Smith factors 1^40,5. Eliminating upward-matched 3-faces uses the oriented boundary of their matched 4-faces; downward-matched 3-faces vanish in the Morse quotient. Acyclicity makes elimination triangular. The one-vertex Morse CW model has 3-skeleton a wedge of S^3, so Hurewicz classifies the attaching maps of 4-cells by their integer degrees. Both changes of basis in the Smith reduction are realized by homotopy equivalences of the target and source wedges of S^3 in the attaching-map cofiber. The unit factors cancel, the factor 5 gives the Moore space, and the free sphere multiplicities are 205 and 4. The original complex, not the Morse model, is pure of dimension 11 (its 25 distinct maximal neighborhoods have size 12), so its nonzero reduced H3 rules out pure shellability. The primary matching alone is decisive; the alternate frozen computation is not claimed as an additional independent replay.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Forman's theorem gives the earlier CW skeleton; pi3 of its 3-sphere wedge is the free degree group. Smith maps on both wedges are homotopy equivalences, so its cofiber is the claimed Moore wedge with 262−57 = 205 three-spheres and 61−57 = 4 four-spheres. This is stronger evidence than overlap of homology alone.

originality.rationale: The 2026-10-25 Resultary record 94202559c076 already gives the exact integral homology of the identical open-neighborhood complex. Although it expressly does not claim the Moore wedge, its certified collapse and discrete Morse proof already supply a CW model with a single 0-cell, 262 3-cells and 61 4-cells, and its integral attaching-degree matrix has Smith factors 1^56,5. These decisive stronger inputs make the frozen homotopy statement a routine cofiber/Smith consequence of the earlier proof, without any additional topological information. The new matching produces a second certificate of that result rather than an original finding.
residual_risks: Other exact literature may exist; the negative decision depends on a positive earlier match and its implication, not on search exhaustiveness.

value.rationale: The natural torsion example would be significant as an unknown exact invariant, but its exact integral homology and a Morse CW model sufficient for the Moore wedge were already available. Applying routine Smith diagonalization of simply connected two-level attaching maps and adding a different certificate do not supply a distinct mathematical gain. No repair is proposed: a genuinely new equivariant or comparative theorem would require new work.
